Before you pay

Buyers must independently verify the artist, artwork ownership and authenticity, original/print/digital format, condition, total price, payment recipient, delivery and refund terms before any transaction. Ask for recent artwork evidence and keep written records. You transact directly with the artist; RoamWise does not hold these payments or guarantee authenticity, delivery or refunds.

A RoamWise “Instagram profile checked” badge means we reviewed the linked public profile and its portfolio consistency. It is not Instagram/Meta verification, identity or ownership verification, or buyer protection. Featured, Ambassador and Founding Artist labels are not verification badges. Report a concern.

RakhiAipan Art Rakhi · Haldwani, Uttarakhand

Aipan Art Rakhi brings the traditional folk art of Kumaon to paintings and decorative pieces. Based in Haldwani, Uttarakhand, the studio offers Aipan work on canvas, wood, cloth and metal, and shares the craft through workshops. Contact Rakhi directly to explore the collection and discuss your requirements.
